meta.name: migrate-memory
meta.description: Migrate legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory into the shared memory tree and provider-neutral standing instructions. Run after an update reports the shared-memory breaking change, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md/CLAUDE.local.md, Claude auto-memory, or an unindexed imported-agent-memory.md. Triggers on "migrate memory", "legacy memory", "the agent forgot everything after the switch".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将旧版记忆迁移到共享记忆树和持久指令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果升级后智能体记忆失效或仍有旧版记忆文件
copy.tagline_en: Migrate legacy memory to shared memory tree and standing instructions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent forgot everything after a shared-memory breaking change

howto.what: 把旧版 NanoClaw 和 Claude 原生记忆文件迁移到共享记忆树，整理成统一索引和标准指令。它会先列出受影响的组、暂停相关任务并停止容器，经你批准后移动文件，最后生成来源-目标报告并验证迁移结果。
howto.when: 当更新后共享记忆不兼容，或组里残留 .seed.md、CLAUDE.md 等旧文件时触发；你说“migrate memory”“legacy memory”等也会触发。

say.text: 请把项目里的旧记忆迁移到共享记忆树。
say.note: 会先列出受影响组并请求批准。

say.text: 我的 agent 切换后什么都忘了，帮我迁移记忆。
把 CLAUDE.md 迁移成新格式。
say.note: 会暂存该文件并分类整理。

howto.what_en: Migrates legacy NanoClaw and Claude-native memory files into the shared memory tree, organized into unified indexes and standard instructions. It lists affected groups, pauses tasks, stops containers, moves files after approval, and produces a source-to-destination report with verification.
howto.when_en: Runs after an update reports shared-memory breaking changes, or when a group still has .seed.md, legacy CLAUDE.md, etc. Also triggered by phrases like 'migrate memory' or 'legacy memory'.

say_en.text: Please migrate the project's legacy memory to the shared memory tree.
say_en.note: It will check affected groups and ask for approval.

say_en.text: My agent forgot everything after the switch—please migrate its memory.
say_en.note: This starts the standard migration workflow.

say_en.text: Migrate CLAUDE.md to the new format.
say_en.note: It will be staged and classified.
